name: Snowflake Custom Query
description: Runs a SQL query on Snowflake, signing in with a password or a key pair, and outputs the result.
introductoryText:
Runs a SQL query on Snowflake and brings the result into the workflow. The whole result is read into memory. The core **Database** block also connects to Snowflake (choose Snowflake as the connection) and is the better choice for large tables; this block is a short Python script you can open and adapt, for example to set session parameters or reshape the result.

**How to set it up**

1. Enter the **Account identifier** (the part of your Snowflake address before `.snowflakecomputing.com`, for example `myorg-myaccount`) and the **User**.
2. Sign in with a **Password**, or with a key pair: the path of the **Private key file** (PEM, PKCS#8) on the Omniscope server and, if the key is encrypted, its **Private key password**. Snowflake accounts that block password sign-in need the key pair. The key file wins when both are given.
3. Optionally choose the **Warehouse**, **Database**, **Schema** and **Role**; empty ones use the user's defaults.
4. Type the **SQL query**. Name tables in full (`database.schema.table`) unless you set the database and schema.

Snowflake returns unquoted column names in capitals. NUMBER values with decimals arrive as decimal numbers, TIMESTAMP_TZ and TIMESTAMP_LTZ in UTC, TIME as text.

options.name: account
options.title: Account identifier
options.description: The part of your Snowflake address before .snowflakecomputing.com, for example myorg-myaccount (or a locator such as xy12345.eu-west-1).

options.name: user
options.title: User
options.description: The Snowflake user to sign in as.

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: The user's password. Leave empty when signing in with a private key file.

options.name: private_key_file
options.title: Private key file
options.description: For key-pair sign-in: the path, on the Omniscope server, of the user's private key (PEM, PKCS#8). Used instead of the password. Keep it outside any shared folder.

options.name: private_key_password
options.title: Private key password
options.description: The passphrase of an encrypted private key. Leave empty for an unencrypted key.

options.name: warehouse
options.title: Warehouse
options.description: Optional. The warehouse that runs the query, for example COMPUTE_WH. Empty: the user's default warehouse.

options.name: database
options.title: Database
options.description: Optional. The database for table names that don't name one, for example SALES. Empty: the user's default.

options.name: schema
options.title: Schema
options.description: Optional. The schema for table names that don't name one, for example PUBLIC.

options.name: role
options.title: Role
options.description: Optional. The role to use, for example ANALYST. Empty: the user's default role.

options.name: custom_sql
options.title: SQL query
options.description: The query to run, for example SELECT REGION, SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM SALES.PUBLIC.ORDERS GROUP BY REGION.

blockOutputs.label: Results
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per row the query returns, with the query's columns as fields.
